info.title: Intelligent Document AI API
info.description:
Upload documents, extract and understand them, and ask questions answered only from
your documents, with citations to the page and passage.

**Auth:** `POST /api/v1/auth/login` returns a bearer access token (15 min) and sets
an httpOnly refresh cookie. Roles: `viewer` < `member` < `admin`.
Documents are visible only to their owner and the users they are shared with.

**Errors** use RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`).

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Users Get

delete.description: Soft delete: users are deactivated, never removed, to preserve audit history.

post.description:
Upload a document. The type is detected from the file's bytes; processing runs in the
background (poll ``GET /documents/{id}``). Exact duplicates are accepted but reported.

get.description: Line diff between two versions' extracted text (deterministic).

schema.title: Response Version Diff Api V1 Documents  Document Id  Diff Get
Response Set Shares Api V1 Documents  Document Id  Shares Put

get.description: Debug/inspection view of how a document was chunked.

schema.title: Response List Chunks Api V1 Documents  Document Id  Chunks Get
Response List Collections Api V1 Collections Get

delete.description: Documents in the collection are kept (their collection is cleared).

post.description: Hybrid keyword + semantic search over documents the caller may read.

schema.title: Response Run Search Api V1 Search Post
Response List Conversations Api V1 Conversations Get

post.description:
Ask a question. Answers come only from documents the caller can read, with citations.
``status`` is ``answered``, ``not_found``, ``refused`` or ``error``.

schema.title: Response Ask Api V1 Conversations  Conversation Id  Messages Post

get.description:
Conversation history. Citations are re-checked against current access: a citation to a
document that is no longer shared with the caller is hidden.

schema.title: Response History Api V1 Conversations  Conversation Id  Messages Get

post.description:
Pairwise text similarity, changed lines, and field-by-field differences for documents
of the same extracted kind (e.g. two invoices or two contracts).

schema.title: Response Compare Api V1 Compare Post

get.description:
Exact duplicates (same SHA-256) and near-duplicates (MinHash Jaccard ≥ 0.8) among the
current versions of documents the caller may read.

schema.title: Response Duplicates Api V1 Duplicates Get

get.description: What the UI needs to label AI output honestly (which provider/model is active).

Response Stats Api V1 Admin Stats Get
